name: application-variant-selector
title: Variant Selector
description: Color swatch and size button radiogroups for choosing a product variant, with a real out-of-stock state that disables unavailable options.
useWhen: A product has mutually exclusive options (color, size) that must be chosen before adding to cart.
Some option combinations may be unavailable and need a clear, non-interactive out-of-stock state rather than silently disappearing.
Pairing with `product-card` on a product detail page.
avoidWhen: Options aren't mutually exclusive (e.g. multi-select add-ons) — a `toggle-group` in multi-select mode or checkboxes fit that better.
There's only one variant dimension with many options (10+) — a `selects` dropdown may scale better than a wide button row.
Stock state doesn't matter for this catalog — the extra visual treatment for unavailable options isn't worth the complexity.
responsiveBehavior: Color swatches wrap in a flex row; size buttons sit in a fixed 5-column grid that will need adjusting via className override if the option count differs significantly from 5.
accessibility: Each option group is a role="radiogroup" with an aria-label, and each option is role="radio" with aria-checked reflecting selection — single-select semantics, not checkboxes.
Out-of-stock options carry aria-disabled="true" and are excluded from the click handler, not just visually dimmed while remaining clickable.
Out-of-stock color swatches include the out-of-stock state in their aria-label text (e.g. "Sunset Red, out of stock") since the diagonal strike is a purely visual cue.
The selected color/size name is echoed as visible text next to the group label, not conveyed by the swatch/button state alone.

variants.title: Variant Selector
variants.description: Color swatches (one out of stock) and size buttons (one out of stock) with a selected state for each group.
accessibility: Out-of-stock options cannot be selected via the click handler even if a user manages to focus them.

variants.title: Variant Selector (Dark)
variants.description: Variant selector adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-state ring and border colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
